title: Power Stack — September NFP / Treasury Duration Refresh
scope: Bond watch and portfolio macro overlay only. No company fundamental scores changed.

marketReaction.oil: down more than 3% intraday; bond-friendly near term, but refined-product scarcity remains unresolved

powerStackRead.regime: Do not overwrite Live Desk canonical regime from this single event. Treat NFP as a material counter-signal to the rates-led tightening regime and a trigger for deeper duration research.
powerStackRead.bonds: Intermediate duration is the cleaner first expression. TLT moves from pure watch toward tactical starter/watch because convexity is now attractive, but confirmation from 20Y/30Y and real yields is still required.
powerStackRead.portfolio: Lower yields improve the discount-rate backdrop for TSLA, YTLPOWR and premium AI/power names. Falling crude is a near-term counterweight for XOM/MISC/HIBISCS/DAYANG. No company-evidence score changes are justified from the macro move alone.

tlt.note: Short interest can add squeeze fuel. Duration creates roughly 3.7% price sensitivity for a 25 bp parallel yield move before convexity/carry; that works in both directions.

risks: Late-Labor-Day seasonal adjustment may have depressed September payrolls; subsequent revisions matter.
Inflation remains above target and diesel/product markets are still tight.
Treasury supply/term premium can keep 20Y/30Y yields high even if the Fed pauses in October.
A December hike remains a live/high-probability market outcome.
